    df_final['debate_year'] - df_final['HouseStartYear']

5.4.1 Impact of Gender on Framing Patterns¶

In [382]:
# ---------------------------------------
# Compute number of unique speakers per year and gender
# ---------------------------------------
# Create a clean working copy
df_gender = df_final.copy()
# Keep only rows with valid IDs and gender/year information
df_gender = df_gender.dropna(subset=['twfy_id', 'Gender', 'debate_year'])
# Count unique speakers by year and gender
unique_speakers_per_year = (
    df_gender
    .groupby(['debate_year', 'Gender'])['twfy_id']
    .nunique()
    .reset_index(name='unique_speakers')
)
# Pivot into wide format: rows = year, columns = gender
pivot = unique_speakers_per_year.pivot(
    index='debate_year',
    columns='Gender',
    values='unique_speakers'
).fillna(0)
# Compute percentage composition per year
pivot_percent = pivot.div(pivot.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

# ---------------------------------------
# Plot the number of unique speakers
# ---------------------------------------
# Define gender colors
GENDER_COLORS = {
    'F': "#B5D1EA", # LIGHT_BLUE
    'M': "#3E8CCB" # BLUE
}

# Set font properties BEFORE creating the plot
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12
plt.rcParams['figure.titlesize'] = 14

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

pivot.plot(
    kind='bar',
    ax=ax,
    rot=45,
    color=[GENDER_COLORS.get(col, "#A0A0A0") for col in pivot.columns]
)

ax.set_title("Unique Speakers per Year by Gender", fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel("Year", fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Unique Speakers", fontsize=12)
ax.legend(title="Gender")

# Style adjustments
ax.grid(axis='x', visible=False)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

# Add percentage labels above bars
for i, year in enumerate(pivot.index):
    total = pivot.loc[year].sum()
    for j, gender in enumerate(pivot.columns):
        value = pivot.loc[year, gender]
        pct = pivot_percent.loc[year, gender]
        # Approximate bar positions for grouped bars
        bar_x = i + (j - 0.5) * 0.4
        bar_y = value
        ax.text(
            bar_x,
            bar_y + total * 0.02,
            f"{pct:.1f}%",
            ha='center',
            va='bottom',
            fontsize=10
        )

# Set maximum y-value to 500
ax.set_ylim(0, 500)

# Layout anpassen
plt.tight_layout(pad=2.0)
plt.show()

# ---------------------------------------------
# Build contingency table for Gender × Frame
# ---------------------------------------------
cont_table = pd.crosstab(df_final['Gender'], df_final['frame_label'])

# Perform Chi-square test
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(cont_table)

# Compute standardized residuals
std_residuals = (cont_table - expected) / np.sqrt(expected)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Visualize deviations using a heatmap
# --------------------------------------------------
# Set font to Times New Roman
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 14

# Create custom colormap using your colors
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# Define colors: dark orange (very negative) → light orange → grey (zero) → light blue → dark blue (very positive)
colors = ["#D35400", ORANGE_HIGHLIGHT, VERY_LIGHT_GREY, LIGHT_BLUE, BLUE, DARK_BLUE]
n_bins = 256
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('custom_diverging', colors, N=n_bins)

# Get min and max values for symmetric scale
vmin = std_residuals.min().min()
vmax = std_residuals.max().max()
abs_max = max(abs(vmin), abs(vmax))

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.heatmap(
    std_residuals,
    annot=True,
    fmt=".2f",
    cmap=cmap,
    center=0,
    vmin=-abs_max,
    vmax=abs_max,
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Standardized Residuals'},
    annot_kws={'fontsize': 14}
)
plt.title("Heatmap: Frame Deviations by Gender (Standardized Residuals)", 
          fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
plt.xlabel("Frame Label", fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel("Gender", fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(fontsize=14)
plt.yticks(fontsize=14)

# Colorbar font size
cbar = plt.gca().collections[0].colorbar
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=14)
cbar.set_label('Standardized Residuals', fontsize=14)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ---------------------------------------------
# Contingency table for Gender × Frame
# ---------------------------------------------
cont_table = pd.crosstab(df_final['Gender'], df_final['frame_label'])

# Chi-square test
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(cont_table)

# Compute Cramér’s V as effect size
n = cont_table.sum().sum()
k = min(cont_table.shape) - 1
cramers_v = math.sqrt(chi2 / (n * k))

# ---------------------------------------------
# Output results
# ---------------------------------------------
print("=== Chi-Square Test: Gender × Frame ===")
print(f"Chi² statistic: {chi2:.3f}")
print(f"Degrees of freedom: {dof}")
print(f"P-value: {p:.6f}")
print(f"Cramér's V: {cramers_v:.3f}\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Filter dataset: require valid Party, Gender, and MP ID
# ----------------------------------------------------------
df_party = df_final.dropna(subset=['Party', 'Gender', 'twfy_id'])

# Count unique MPs per party
party_sizes = (
    df_party.groupby('Party')['twfy_id']
    .nunique()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
)

# Identify the 5 largest parties
top5_parties = party_sizes.head(5).index.tolist()
print("Top 5 parties:", top5_parties)

# Filter to only MPs from the top 5 parties
df_top5 = df_party[df_party['Party'].isin(top5_parties)]

# Count unique MPs by party & gender
party_gender = (
    df_top5.groupby(['Party', 'Gender'])['twfy_id']
    .nunique()
    .reset_index(name='unique_mps')
)

# Pivot into wide format
party_gender_pivot = party_gender.pivot(
    index='Party',
    columns='Gender',
    values='unique_mps'
).fillna(0)

# Ensure consistent ordering
party_gender_pivot = party_gender_pivot.loc[top5_parties]

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1: Absolute number of MPs by gender and party
# ----------------------------------------------------------
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

party_gender_pivot.plot(
    kind='bar',
    figsize=(12,6),
    color=['#4C72B0', '#DD8452'],
    rot=45,
    width=0.8
)

plt.title("Unique MPs by Party and Gender (Top 5 Parties)", fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel("Party", fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel("Number of MPs", fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title="Gender")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2: Percentage distribution of gender within parties
# ----------------------------------------------------------
party_gender_percent = (
    party_gender_pivot.div(party_gender_pivot.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100
)

plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))

)

# Analyze distribution of frame labels across speaker age groups using stacked bar charts.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare dataset
df_age = df_final.copy()
df_age = df_age.dropna(subset=['age_at_speech', 'frame_label'])

bins = [20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80]
labels = ['20–29', '30–39', '40–49', '50–59', '60–69', '70–79']

# Assign age groups
df_age['age_group'] = pd.cut(df_age['age_at_speech'], bins=bins, labels=labels, right=False)
df_age = df_age.dropna(subset=['age_group'])

# Count frames per age group
age_frame_counts = (
    df_age.groupby(['age_group', 'frame_label'])
    .size()
    .unstack(fill_value=0)
    .reindex(labels)
)

# Plot stacked bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))

bottom = None
for frame in age_frame_counts.columns:
    plt.bar(
        age_frame_counts.index,
        age_frame_counts[frame],
        bottom=bottom,
        label=frame
    )
    bottom = age_frame_counts[frame] if bottom is None else bottom + age_frame_counts[frame]

plt.title("Age Distribution of Speech Chunks by Frame")
plt.xlabel("Age Group at Speech")
plt.ylabel("Number of Speech Chunks")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.legend(title="Frame Label")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Chi-square independence test between age groups and frame labels, with standardized residuals heatmap.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare dataset
df_ageframe = df_final.dropna(subset=['age_at_speech', 'frame_label']).copy()
age_bins = [20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 100]
age_labels = ["20–29", "30–39", "40–49", "50–59", "60–69", "70–79"]
df_ageframe['age_group'] = pd.cut(
    df_ageframe['age_at_speech'],
    bins=age_bins,
    labels=age_labels,
    right=False
)
df_ageframe = df_ageframe.dropna(subset=['age_group'])

# Build contingency table
contingency = pd.crosstab(df_ageframe['age_group'], df_ageframe['frame_label'])

# Chi-square test
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency)

# Compute standardized residuals
std_residuals = (contingency - expected) / np.sqrt(expected)

# Set font to Times New Roman
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Create custom colormap using your colors
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# Define colors: dark orange (very negative) → light orange → grey (zero) → light blue → dark blue (very positive)
colors = ["#D35400", ORANGE_HIGHLIGHT, VERY_LIGHT_GREY, LIGHT_BLUE, BLUE, DARK_BLUE]
n_bins = 256
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('custom_diverging', colors, N=n_bins)

# Get min and max values for symmetric scale
vmin = std_residuals.min().min()
vmax = std_residuals.max().max()
abs_max = max(abs(vmin), abs(vmax))

# Heatmap visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.heatmap(
    std_residuals,
    annot=True,
    cmap=cmap,
    center=0,
    vmin=-abs_max,
    vmax=abs_max,
    fmt=".2f",
    linewidths=0.5,
    annot_kws={'fontsize': 12},
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Standardized Residuals'}
)
plt.title("Heatmap: Frame Deviations by Age Group (Standardized Residuals)", 
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
plt.xlabel("Frame Label", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Age Group at Speech", fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=12)
plt.yticks(fontsize=12)

# Colorbar font size
cbar = plt.gca().collections[0].colorbar
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=12)
cbar.set_label('Standardized Residuals', fontsize=12)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("=== Chi-Square Test: Age Group × Frame ===")
print(f"Chi²: {chi2:.3f}")
print(f"p-value: {p:.6f}")
print(f"Degrees of freedom: {dof}")
